scope: Planned evaluation framework for canonical product experiments beyond the CAP-001 conformance suite
method: Freeze the experiment-specific protocol, cases, versions, measures, stop rules, and evidence boundary before execution.
Use the relevant CTS items plus experiment-specific technical, human, safety, customer, and cost measures.
Record negative, failed, and inconclusive results; a fluent output or CAP-001 fixture pass is never sufficient.
Require scoped implementation and result records before promoting evidence maturity.
claimBoundary: EVAL-003 is a defined plan, not an implemented evaluator or evidence that any listed experiment has run. EVAL-001 remains scoped to CAP-001 deterministic conformance; EVAL-002 remains scoped to the EXP-001 fixture preflight.
